say:1:1241104001:1.text: Since Rustport got blockaded, I've been coming to the shore almost every day.
say:1:1241104001:1.source_cn: 自从锈锚港封锁后……我就会定期来海边逛逛。

choice_prompt:2:1241104001.text: Since Rustport got blockaded, I've been coming to the shore almost every day.
choice_prompt:2:1241104001.source_cn: 自从锈锚港封锁后……我就会定期来海边逛逛。

say:3:1241104002:1.text: That was the plan, but things turned out differently.
say:3:1241104002:1.source_cn: 初衷是来放空，但后面就不一样了。

say:4:1241104003:1.text: This stretch of sea never fails to surprise me. You can never guess what might float ashore.
say:4:1241104003:1.source_cn: 这片海域随时随地都能给我惊喜。你永远都不知道海上漂来的...
say:4:1241104003:1.male: This stretch of sea never fails to surprise me. You can never guess what might float ashore.
say:4:1241104003:1.female: This stretch of sea never fails to surprise me. You can never guess what might float ashore.

say:5:1241104005:1.text: I mean, who would've thought I'd find a mage and a talking hamster?!
say:5:1241104005:1.source_cn: 谁能想到，我居然捡到了一位魔法师和会说话的神奇仓鼠！
say:5:1241104005:1.male: I mean, who would've thought I'd find a mage and a talking hamster?!
say:5:1241104005:1.female: I mean, who would've thought I'd find a mage and a talking hamster?!

say:6:1241104006:1.text: I'll be able to brag about this for months!
say:6:1241104006:1.source_cn: 这可够我吹嘘一阵子了。

choice_prompt:7:1241104006.text: I'll be able to brag about this for months!
choice_prompt:7:1241104006.source_cn: 这可够我吹嘘一阵子了。

say:8:1241104007:1.text: Most of the time you just get a bunch of useless junk. Smelly seaweed, broken planks, shattered lanterns...
say:8:1241104007:1.source_cn: 大多数时候，是没什么用又莫名其妙的垃圾。比如发臭的海藻...

say:9:1241104008:1.text: When the tide is high, you can pick up fish, clams, crabs, oysters, and sea snails along the beach… these make for a pretty good feast.
say:9:1241104008:1.source_cn: 涨潮后，沙滩上能捡到鱼、贝壳、螃蟹、牡蛎、海螺……这些...

say:10:1241104009:1.text: When it doesn't rain, I get a fire going on the beach and grill them up. Once they're cooked and seasoned with some sea salt, you can't beat the taste!
say:10:1241104009:1.source_cn: 如果不下雨，我就在海边架个火堆烤上，等烤出汁撒点海盐，...

choice_prompt:11:1241104009.text: When it doesn't rain, I get a fire going on the beach and grill them up. Once they're cooked and seasoned with some sea salt, you can't beat the taste!
choice_prompt:11:1241104009.source_cn: 如果不下雨，我就在海边架个火堆烤上，等烤出汁撒点海盐，吃起来鲜得不得了！

say:12:1241104010:1.text: When luck is on my side, I sometimes find chests stuffed with goods, though most of them are locked tight.
say:12:1241104010:1.source_cn: 运气好的时候，也能发现装着财产的匣子，不过多半都上了锁。

say:13:1241104011:1.text: Even if you can break them open, what's inside usually isn't worth much. I spent an hour prying open a chest one afternoon just to find a soggy diary.
say:13:1241104011:1.source_cn: 多数时候，就算砸开，也捞不到多少钱。我撬开过一只木箱，...

say:14:1241104012:1.text: Other than that, I've found shattered hand mirrors and waterlogged music boxes… I guess the fact that the chests are locked means the owners must've really valued them.
say:14:1241104012:1.source_cn: 除此之外，碎裂的镜子，进了水的八音盒……既然箱子上了锁...

say:15:1241104013:1.text: People treasure all sorts of strange things, it's pretty interesting. Although, they all ultimately face Destiny's Call.
say:15:1241104013:1.source_cn: 不同人珍视的东西千奇百怪，什么都有，很有意思。虽然都逃...

say:16:1241104014:1.text: One time, I found half a gold coin in the sand...
say:16:1241104014:1.source_cn: 还有一次，我在沙滩上捡到半枚金币……

say:19:1241104016:1.text: Maybe a fish bit through it and spat it back out?
say:19:1241104016:1.source_cn: 我猜，可能是海里的鱼吃下去的时候硌牙，所以吐了出来？

say:22:1241104019:1.text: I've come across even scarier things, so bloated up with water that… Well, I'll keep it to myself so no one feels ill.
say:22:1241104019:1.source_cn: 我还捡到过更可怕的，比如什么泡涨了的……呃，为了不倒胃...

say:23:1241104020:1.text: In any case, you just never know what might wash up on the beaches of Rustport.
say:23:1241104020:1.source_cn: 总之，在锈锚港的海滩上，能捡到各种各样的东西。

say:25:1241104022:1.text: So you caught my drift! Well, let's not get into anything gloomy.
say:25:1241104022:1.source_cn: 哟，能听懂我的话外之意！好啦，别提那么扫兴的事。

say:26:1241104023:1.text: But in all my time scavenging by the sea, you're the most intact person—and the cutest hamster—I've ever picked up!
say:26:1241104023:1.source_cn: 我在海边待了这么多年，这么多年里，你们是我捡到的最健全...

choice:7:0:1.text: What else have you found here?
choice:7:0:1.male: What else have you found here?
choice:7:0:1.female: What else have you found here?

choice:2:0:1.text: Come to the seaside to unwind?
choice:2:0:1.male: Come to the seaside to unwind?
choice:2:0:1.female: Come to the seaside to unwind?

say:28:1241104004:1.text: Isn't it great? You just never know what'll float in from the sea.
say:28:1241104004:1.source_cn: 不觉得很有趣吗？你永远都不知道从海上会漂来什么东西。
say:28:1241104004:1.male: Isn't it great? You just never know what'll float in from the sea.
say:28:1241104004:1.female: Isn't it great? You just never know what'll float in from the sea.

choice:2:1:2.text: Visit the shore to collect things?
choice:2:1:2.male: Visit the shore to collect things?
choice:2:1:2.female: Visit the shore to collect things?
